name: Golden Hour
author: Sweepercom
credit: Golden Hour template by Sweepercom; inspired by Instagram's profile layout
description: An Instagram-style profile: story-ring avatar, a stat row built around your real follower count, tappable highlights that open full story cards, and JanitorAI's own character list turned into a three-across grid that updates itself.

components.name: Black backdrop & system type
components.blurb: The flat black page and the system font the whole profile is set in.

components.name: Profile header
components.blurb: The centred column and the header grid: the avatar in its story ring, your username, follower count, badges, and the Follow and Options buttons. Includes its phone layout.

components.name: Launch splash
components.blurb: A one-second app-launch screen with a gradient mark.

components.name: Stats & bio
components.blurb: The two extra counts beside your followers, your display name, category, bio text, link, and a friends line.

components.name: Highlights & stories
components.blurb: A row of highlight circles. Each opens a full-screen story card with a progress bar, previous and next arrows, and its own content: about, rules, requests, links and friends.

components.name: Character grid
components.blurb: JanitorAI's own character list as a three-across grid of picture tiles; pointing at one shows its name, tags and chat count. The tab, search and pagination are restyled to match.

components.name: Header & menus
components.blurb: The site header, search, user menu and the phone navigation bar in flat black and grey.

components.name: Floating notifications
components.blurb: The notification bell leaves the header and becomes a pill in the bottom corner, the way a message inbox floats; its panel opens upward as a list of round pictures. On a phone the bell stays in the header and only the panel is restyled.

components.name: Template credit
components.blurb: A small credit line under the highlights.

assets.label: Optional highlight cover pictures
assets.placement: Replace the symbol inside a gh-hl-cover element with an img

notes: The avatar, username, follower count, badges and Follow button are JanitorAI's own elements, restyled.
The character grid is the native list, so it needs no edits when a bot is published.
The bot and chat counts beside the follower count are written by hand.
Stories open with :target; the page has one target, so only one story is open at a time.
The floating notifications pill removes the blur behind JanitorAI's header; a blurred header would keep the pill pinned inside it.
No CSS background images or custom properties are used.
